label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa contra gentiles I.13: The most efficacious way to prove that GOD_2 exists is…
locator: I.13 [30]: The most efficacious way to prove that God exists is on the supposition that the world is eternal
interpretation: Reply to the objection ([29]) that the proofs presuppose the eternity of motion, which Catholics hold false: they are argued on the supposition of an eternal world, which makes God's existence less manifest; if the world had a first beginning, a cause of its origin is evident. Read as Aquinas's dilemma strategy: argue on the eternity hypothesis, and cover the other horn separately. It supports treating STMT-PAST-IS-INFINITE as a hypothesis, not as Aquinas's assertion.
